title: OSR Test File
description: A JSON file containing symbolic test problems. Conforms to EARS Specification OSR v0.1, §12.

section.description: Taxonomy section identifier corresponding to the rules being tested.

title.description: Human-readable title of this test section.

test-problem.description: A single symbolic test problem. Per OSR-V-002.

expression.description: The input expression, in OSR-Expr format.

variable.description: The primary variable (plain symbol, no wildcard suffix).

expected_result.description: The optimal expected rewritten expression in OSR-Expr format. Results are compared by symbolic equivalence, not syntactic equality. Per OSR-V-003.

num_steps.description: Expected number of rule application steps. Positive: steps needed. Zero: trivial. Negative: OSR cannot rewrite (absolute value may indicate complexity).

grade.description: Expected grade on the OSR scale: A (≤2× optimal size), B (>2× but correct), C (correct, sub-optimal), F (incorrect/timeout). Per OSR-V-004.

comment.description: Free-form comment about this test problem.
